Mr. Sheeran shared the history of the Home Occupation text amendment and reported that in June, there were three main issues staff wanted to address, however, they did not have time to do a full text amendment. They included Business Licensing Appeals, Solicitations, and Home Occupation. Business Licensing Appeals and Solicitation had both been codified. Mr. Sheeran reported that there was a Work Session related to the Home Occupations amendment because it is a policy decision.
